samples.label: 05. Frequency of appeal from administrative courts to administrative courts of appeal by Variable and Year
note: The table illustrates the percentage of cases that have been appealed from administrative court to administrative courts of appeal. The table also shows the frequency of amendment in percent,  that is, when the administrative court of appeal changed the lower court's decision. Both the appeal rate and the amendment rate are divided into total excluding migration cases, migration cases, and removal cases (asylum in migration cases).
The metrics are calculated as the number of incoming cases to the administrative courts of appeal divided by the number of determined cases in the administrative courts during the same time period.
